fact: In August 2023 the Ministry of Justice was training federal investigating police and prosecutors in order to launch the criminal record management information system (CRIMS), covering the process from crime report to sentence, more widely; the first round lasted five days and about one hundred investigators and prosecutors in all were to be trained.
title: መዝገብ አስተዳደር የመረጃ ሥርዓት(CRIMS) በስፋት ለማስጀመር ያለመ ሥልጠና እየተሰጠ ነዉ
